params.name: ids
params.description: The cases that you want to removed. To get the case identifiers, use the search cases (`_find`) API. In the Dev Console, you can specify the array of cases in the following format: `ids=["e58e77e3-ef8e-4251-926f-efb115f3c4ec"]`. In `curl`, all non-ASCII characters must be URL encoded. For example: `ids=%5B%22e58e77e3-ef8e-4251-926f-efb115f3c4ec%22%5D`

params.name: assignees
params.description: Filters the returned cases by assignees. Valid values are `none` or unique identifiers for the user profiles. These identifiers can be found by using the suggest user profile API.

params.name: category
params.description: Filters the returned cases by category.

params.name: defaultSearchOperator
params.description: he default operator to use for the simple_query_string.

params.name: from
params.description: Returns only cases that were created after a specific date. The date must be specified as a KQL data range or date match expression.

params.name: owner
params.description: A filter to limit the response to a specific set of applications. If this parameter is omitted, the response contains information about all the cases that the user has access to read.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to return.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of items to return. Limited to 100 items.

params.name: reporters
params.description: Filters the returned cases by the user name of the reporter.

params.name: search
params.description: An Elasticsearch simple_query_string query that filters the objects in the response.

params.name: searchFields
params.description: The fields to perform the simple_query_string parsed query against.

params.name: severity
params.description: The severity of the case.

params.name: sortField
params.description: Determines which field is used to sort the results.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Determines the sort order.

params.name: status
params.description: Filters the returned cases by state.

params.name: tags
params.description: Filters the returned cases by tags.

params.name: to
params.description: Returns only cases that were created before a specific date. The date must be specified as a KQL data range or date match expression.
